description: This file implements core transfer functionalities for libcurl, including data transfer management, connection setup, handling redirects, retries, and protocol-specific response processing. It contains functions for initiating, managing, and completing data transfers, as well as handling socket readiness and errors.

methods.name: char * Curl_checkheaders(const struct Curl_easy * data,const char * thisheader,const size_t thislen)
methods.description: Checks the linked list of custom headers in the transfer data for a header starting with the specified prefix.

methods.name: bool Curl_meets_timecondition(struct Curl_easy * data,time_t timeofdoc)
methods.description: Checks if the transfer's time condition has been met based on the remote document's modification time.

methods.name: ssize_t Curl_xfer_recv_resp(struct Curl_easy * data,char * buf,size_t blen,bool eos_reliable,CURLcode * err)
methods.description: Receives raw response data from the connection, respecting the expected data size and connection reliability.

methods.name: CURLcode readwrite_data(struct Curl_easy * data,struct SingleRequest * k,int * didwhat)
methods.description: Handles reading data from the network, managing end-of-stream, and writing response data to the client.

methods.name: CURLcode readwrite_upload(struct Curl_easy * data,int * didwhat)
methods.description: Handles sending data to upload to the server when the socket is writable.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_readwrite(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Main function managing reading and writing data transfers, including socket checking, error handling, and progress updates.

methods.name: void Curl_init_CONNECT(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Initializes connection state before starting a new transfer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_pretransfer(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Prepares the transfer state, including URL processing, authentication, cookie loading, and other setup tasks.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_posttransfer(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Cleanup actions after a transfer completes.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_follow(struct Curl_easy * data,char * newurl,followtype type)
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirect logic, updating URLs, managing redirect limits, and setting up subsequent requests.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_retry_request(struct Curl_easy * data,char ** url)
methods.description: Determines whether to retry a request based on connection reuse, errors, and specific conditions, returning a new URL for retries.

methods.name: void Curl_xfer_setup(struct Curl_easy * data,int sockindex,curl_off_t size,bool getheader,int writesockindex)
methods.description: Sets up socket indices, transfer size, and headers for an upcoming data transfer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_write_resp(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * buf,size_t blen,bool is_eos)
methods.description: Writes received transfer data to the client or protocol handler, handling EOS conditions.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_write_resp_hd(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * hd0,size_t hdlen,bool is_eos)
methods.description: Writes header data, delegating to protocol handlers if available.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_write_done(struct Curl_easy * data,bool premature)
methods.description: Marks the transfer as finished, performing any necessary cleanup.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_send(struct Curl_easy * data,const void * buf,size_t blen,size_t * pnwritten)
methods.description: Sends data to the server over the network socket.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_recv(struct Curl_easy * data,char * buf,size_t blen,ssize_t * pnrcvd)
methods.description: Receives data from the network socket.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_xfer_send_close(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: Terminates sending side of a transfer and performs cleanup.

methods.name: int data_pending(struct Curl_easy * data)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int select_bits_paused(struct Curl_easy * data,int select_bits)
methods.description: unavailable
